fields.name: application_id
fields.description: Id of the application this stage entry belongs to.

fields.name: job_interview_stage_id
fields.description: Id of the interview stage occupied during this entry. References a `/v3/job_interview_stages` row scoped to the application's job.

fields.name: entered_at
fields.description: Timestamp the application entered this stage, in ISO 8601. `null` only for backfilled or partially recorded history.

fields.name: exited_at
fields.description: Timestamp the application left this stage, in ISO 8601. `null` while the application is still in this stage (the current stage entry).

fields.name: days_in_stage
fields.description: Whole number of calendar days the application has spent in this stage, computed as `exited_at - entered_at` for past stages and `now - entered_at` for the current stage.

fields.name: current
fields.description: `true` when this row represents the application's current interview stage; `false` for past stage entries in the candidate's history.
